name: adaptive-delegation
description: Orchestrates cost-aware Codex subagents across planning, implementation, and validation with Luna-first routing and evidence-based Sol escalation.

interface.longDescription: Carries explicit delegation intent across a task, assigns exclusive implementation ownership where safe, uses Luna for normal subagent tasks, and escalates stuck or high-value reasoning work to Sol.
defaultPrompt: Use adaptive delegation across planning, implementation, and validation for this complex task.
Parallelize this only where it will materially help.
Use Luna first and escalate stuck implementation work to Sol.
